## About

Professor Dunn's research group studies the impact of crystalline defects and chemical inhomogeneities in advanced materials. These defects impact the properties and behavior of nanomaterials particularly dramatically, because the number of atoms participating in those boundaries constitutes an appreciable fraction of the total atoms in the sample.

As a result, observable properties are often dominated by interface, not bulk, material properties.
